protocol: Volunteers exposed during routine chamber runs at 25,000 ft equivalent altitude in an Australian biomarker study. Four experimental controls are separate from the exposed group.
outcome_window: Reported during the study. The abstract gives timed blood samples and no defined clinical surveillance window.
locator: Author abstract, Methods and final paragraph, issue pp. 415–417
note: Eleven male and two female exposed volunteers. Exact number and location of runs, repeat attendance and DCS definition unavailable. The four controls do not contribute to the exposed denominator.
